biggest_catch: Only for people residing in Kenton, Boone, or Campbell County, Kentucky (northern KY) - not the whole state - and you must not have had a UKFCU checking account within the past 12 months.
catches: Geographic restriction: members residing in Kenton, Boone, or Campbell County, KY only (northern Kentucky)
Must not have had a checking account with UKFCU within the past 12 months
Requires 25 or more debit card transactions within 120 days of account opening
Requires at least three recurring payroll direct deposits totaling at least $3,000 into the new account within 120 days
Account balance must be above $0.00 at the time of bonus payment
Does not apply to Student Rewards Accounts or Business Checking Accounts
Offer valid June 30, 2026 through December 31, 2026; UKFCU may change the promotional period without notice
Bonus funds may be reported as taxable income on Form 1099-INT

payout_quote: WELCOMENKY - New Checking Account $500 Promotion. This disclosure is for any member residing in Kenton, Boone, or Campbell County that opens a new checking account with direct deposit using promo code WELCOMENKY. The member may not have had a checking account within the past 12 months. Within 120 days of account opening, the member must meet the following requirements to earn the $500 bonus: (1) complete 25 or more debit card transactions; (2) receive at least three recurring payroll direct deposits totaling at least $3,000 into the new account; and (3) maintain an account balance above $0.00 at the time of bonus payment. If all qualifications are met, the $500 bonus will be deposited into the primary checking account within 8 business days after completion. Bonus funds may be reported as taxable income on Form 1099-INT. Offer valid June 30 2026, through December 31, 2026. UK Credit Union reserves the right to change the promotional period at any time, without notice.
payout_value_note: $500 flat bonus for meeting all three requirements within 120 days.

Keep the account balance above $0.00 at the time of bonus payment; the $500 bonus is deposited within 8 business days after completion
